summary: Verified PostManagementMenu portal refactor and text-wrap CSS hardening. Portal architecture confirmed: backdrop AND mobile menu are direct children of document.body (parentElement.tagName === 'BODY'), no longer nested in the post card. At 375x800 the backdrop is fixed full-viewport (rect=0,0,375,800), the mobile menu container has computed style position:fixed, left:16px, right:16px, maxWidth:343px (= calc(100vw - 32px)), zIndex:9999, and its bounding box stays within the viewport (l=16, r=359). The 2x2 vis-grid contains exactly 4 buttons (public/friends/custom/stealth), the title 'Who can see this' is visible, the Delete section has a 1px solid top border, and tapping the backdrop removes both menu+backdrop. The CSS responsiveness is correct: at 375 the mobile container computed display=block and the desktop popover computed display=none (sm:hidden / hidden sm:block working). PATCH /api/posts/{id} is correctly fired on visibility chip click.

critical_code_review_comments: DUPLICATE data-testids in DOM (test fragility, not a user-facing bug): PostManagementMenu.jsx renders the SAME `MenuBody` JSX inside BOTH the mobile container (sm:hidden) AND the desktop container (hidden sm:block) whenever `open && anchorRect` are truthy. That means child testids like `feed-manage-{id}-title`, `-vis-grid`, `-vis-public`, `-vis-friends`, `-vis-custom`, `-vis-stealth`, `-delete`, `-close`, `-error` all appear TWICE in the document at every viewport (one is hidden via display:none by the responsive utility classes, the other is visible). Functionally fine for users (CSS hides the inactive variant and event handlers on the hidden subtree never fire), but it breaks the natural `page.getByTestId(...)` testing pattern — tests now have to scope inside `[data-testid=feed-manage-{id}]` (mobile) or `[data-testid=feed-manage-{id}-desktop]` (desktop) to avoid the duplicate. Suggested fix: either (a) suffix the children when rendered inside the desktop popover (e.g., `${tid}-desktop-vis-public`), or (b) pick the variant at render time using `useSyncExternalStore`/`matchMedia('(min-width: 640px)')` so only ONE subtree is mounted at a time.

Spec-correct but cosmetic: the mobile menu's `maxHeight:70vh` + `overflowY:auto` works well at standard heights but on iPhone SE 320x568 the menu can become almost the full screen tall when the user has tons of vis chips wrapped. Not a regression — flagging for awareness.
Permission gating (canManagePost) untouched — non-owners non-founders correctly see ZERO toggles, @stealth/founders see Delete-only on others' posts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on portal/menu spec items verified this run

context_for_next_testing_agent: The PWA 'Add to Home Screen' install prompt (data-testid=install-prompt) randomly re-appears after navigations and blocks clicks with `intercepts pointer events`. Dismiss it via page.get_by_role('button', name='Not now').first.click() OR click [data-testid=install-prompt-close]. At minimum dismiss after every page.goto. The PostManagementMenu now portals to document.body — to verify menu state, query against `document.body` not the post card. When asserting child testids, ALWAYS scope to the mobile (`[data-testid=feed-manage-{id}]`) or desktop (`[data-testid=feed-manage-{id}-desktop]`) container because both subtrees render with identical child testids and only display differs. PATCH /api/posts/{id} payload is `{visibility:'public'|'friends'|'custom'|'stealth'}` — server stores 'stealth' as 'private' in DB and surfaces it back as 'stealth' via currentVisibility().
rca of the issue: n/a — primary spec items all verified working. Duplicate child testids are a maintainability nit, not a defect; main agent can decide whether to suffix desktop variant for cleaner tests.
